difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes that the presheaf-theoretic pushforward g_{p!} is left adjoint to u^p and that the sheaf-theoretic g_! is left adjoint to g^{-1}, exhibiting the two bijection formulas. The sheaf-theoretic formula is derived formally from the presheaf one: for abelian sheaves the Hom-set into g^{-1}G is identified with Hom-sets of presheaves into G, and then with Hom-sets out of g_!F by the universal property of sheafification (proof lines 2833-2872 region, i.e. lines 1833-1872). The presheaf-theoretic adjunction itself is a direct computation from the definitions of u^p and g_{p!}. H2: the two-step derivation through the universal property of sheafification is the substance and is written out.
